work.englishTitle: MAXQ Special Edition Vol. 6: Choi Sohyeon
work.summary: Digital MAXQ Special Edition photobook featuring Choi Sohyeon, a Korean fitness model and Instagram influencer. RIDI identifies the exact Vol. 6 product, a 30-page PDF e-book released on 2021-07-23. Contemporary Korean press describes her Instagram presence and sharing exercise tips with fans. This distinct numbered issue is cataloged without asserting unique photo contents; overlap with her other MAXQ and Secret B releases has not been checked. No ISBN is listed. Metadata only; no cover or paid e-book copied.

edition.contentSummary: RIDI lists MAXQ Special Edition 6 with Choi So-hyun as a 30-page PDF e-book, published 2021-07-23 by MAXQ International; file size 6.7 MB.
